SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'IR_Provider_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Provider2958_') AS IR_Provider_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'IR_Provider_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Provider2958_') AS IR_Provider_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Provider2958_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Provider2958_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958__source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958__source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958__source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958__source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958__sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958__sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2958__sink_TableName;

SELECT  	PRO.PROVIDER_ID                     PROV_PROVIDER_ID 	, SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR              PROV_SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR 	, PRO.SRC_SYS_CD                    PROV_SRC_SYS_CD 	, PRO.NATIONAL_PROVIDER_NBR         PROV_NATIONAL_PROVIDER_NBR 	, PRO.PROV_FULL_NM                  PROV_PROV_FULL_NM 	, PRO.PROV_FACILITY_TYPE_CD         PROV_PROV_FACILITY_TYPE_CD 	, PRO.PROV_ADDR_ID                  PROV_PROV_ADDR_ID 	, PRO.PRAC_ID                       PROV_PRAC_ID 	, PROA.PROV_ADDR_ID                 PROA_PROV_ADDR_ID 	, PROA.PROV_ADDR_BEGIN_DT           PROA_PROV_ADDR_BEGIN_DT 	, PROA.ADDRESS_TYPE_CD              PROA_ADDRESS_TYPE_CD 	, PROA.SRC_SYS_CD                   PROA_SRC_SYS_CD 	, PROA.PROV_ADDR_END_DT             PROA_PROV_ADDR_END_DT 	, PROA.PROV_ADDR_LINE1              PROA_PROV_ADDR_LINE1 	, PROA.PROV_ADDR_LINE2              PROA_PROV_ADDR_LINE2 	, PROA.PROV_ADDR_LINE3              PROA_PROV_ADDR_LINE3 	, PROA.PROV_CITY_NM                 PROA_PROV_CITY_NM 	, PROA.PROV_COUNTY_CD               PROA_PROV_COUNTY_CD 	, PROA.PROV_STATE_CD                PROA_PROV_STATE_CD 	, PROA.PROV_ZIP5                    PROA_PROV_ZIP5 	, PROA.PROV_ZIP4                    PROA_PROV_ZIP4 	, PROA.PROV_OFFICE_PHONE_NBR        PROA_PROV_OFFICE_PHONE_NBR 	, PROA.PROV_OFFICE_PHONE_EXT        PROA_PROV_OFFICE_PHONE_EXT 	, PROA.PROV_CELL_NBR                PROA_PROV_CELL_NBR 	, PROA.PROV_EMAIL                   PROA_PROV_EMAIL FROM INTEGRATION_REPOSITORY.dbo.PROVIDER PRO INNER JOIN INTEGRATION_REPOSITORY.dbo.PROVIDER_ADDRESS PROA 	ON (    PRO.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = 'N' 		AND PRO.EDIT_ERROR_IND = 'N' 		AND PRO.PRAC_ID IS NOT NULL 		AND PROA.PROV_ADDR_ID = PRO.PROV_ADDR_ID 		AND PROA.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = 'N' 	   )	  INNER JOIN    ( 	 select PROV_ADDR_ID, max(PROV_ADDR_BEGIN_DT) as MAX_ADDR_DT 	 from PROVIDER_ADDRESS 	 where (GETDATE() BETWEEN PROV_ADDR_BEGIN_DT and PROV_ADDR_END_DT) 	 AND ADDRESS_TYPE_CD = 'PRI' 	 added 02/03/09 Amanda Dalton 	 AND LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = 'N' 	 group by PROV_ADDR_ID    ) MAX_PRI_ADDR    ON ( MAX_PRI_ADDR.PROV_ADDR_ID = PROA.PROV_ADDR_ID         AND MAX_PRI_ADDR.MAX_ADDR_DT = PROA.PROV_ADDR_BEGIN_DT         AND PROA.ADDRESS_TYPE_CD = 'PRI'        )
